notes.title: The continuation of the "Evil Manager" series release in less than 24 hours!
notes.notes:
We've been waiting for this day... and in less than 24 hours there will be a release of the sequel to "Evil Manager". In the first game, you played as banker - Evil Bank Manager. In the second game, you can become election campaign manager. 
Germany in 1932 was definitely in political crisis. There were several elections in a row during the year. At this point in history, only a few extra percent who voted for the Nazis changed history. Hitler became Chancellor of Germany. You'll have to change that by taking over one of the parties. You must win the election and keep the Nazis from coming to power.
The game also includes the scenarios of Great Britain (not letting Chamberlain come to power) and France.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1219950

notes.title: One more big update (Balance Editing, Farm and Grain Processing)
notes.notes:
After two so large-scale updates like Science and Events, it was clear that I would have to correct the numbers.
We carefully read all your reviews and made several key edits:
1. Now the player gets a lot less for investing gold in the war. Previously, the player received an additional 20% gold for investments, which of course is too much. Now this amount is limited to 5%. True, the player will still receive a bonus for searching for investments, which increases the total amount.
2. Reduced profit per search investment. This figure was also too high.
3. Some sciences have been changed to more logical ones in their branches (5 sciences have been replaced).
4. The initial bonuses of some sciences have been reduced (9 sciences).
5. Changing farms and grains. Now the grain is 2.5-3 times more expensive. So you get much more profit from it. Sowing of grain occurs in spring and harvest in autumn. Also now, gold is not spent for sowing. So I guess right now we made them playeble in regions that is not going to become war-zone

We hope that this update will close those problems that have arisen and will make the game more variable. Plus of course we fixed bug with armory
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825583/d6877fc874714edae8ed6a24392343d48655a121.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Another big update! (6 kinds of events)
notes.notes:
Yesterday we added another big update. Now you can see why we decided to spend the last 3 weeks on these updates (Science and Events).
In this update, we have added events that can occur on the map. They will be provoked by bad events on the map or good ones. Typically, an event captures from 5 to 25 regions and in fact is very ambitious. Hunger, riots, scientific boom, industrial boom and other types of events affect the wealth of the regions.
Bad events greatly reduce the parameters of the regions, which of course greatly reduces the profits from property in these regions. So you have to either sell everything in these regions, or rebuild the area anew (agriculture, industry and infrastructure).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825583/0aef7b264dc78a2eb1f5177b7d311283b6359753.jpg[/img]
Good events, on the contrary, increase these indicators and such regions begin to work at their maximum.
In each event there is an active phase in which you and other banks will be able to intervene. What could be better than sending mercenaries to pacify rebellious peasants and make good money on it?) Or get a job giving orders to regions with an industrial boom?
I really wanted to revive the game with this update and I hope we did it)
Thank you for your support and I hope you will like it.
Your Hamsters Gaming)

notes.title: The most global update! (Science and Industrial Revolution)
notes.notes:
So, we added the update that I really wanted. In essence, science binds together all the functionality and corrects bottlenecks. Maybe some bonuses still need to be set up, but the main thing is that now the game is acquiring a completely different pattern.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825583/f386da8d513525b21980750d26dd21e0d1da12e6.png[/img]
So what can science bonuses give?
- After studying the mercenaries 1 task will always be against the top1 competitor. 
- Ability to make more investments every turn. With the maximum study of science you can buy 3 property in 1 turn.
- Instant recharge of all sciences management countries. At a certain stage, this science will be able to seriously help in the mass capture of neighbors
- Uprising in the country whose flag you chose during registration. Also in the new country you will receive a 25% discount on taxes and this country will be open for you, and all competitors will lose property in the regions that have rebelled.
- Instantly learn multiple Federal Reserve studies
- In case of any war in a country that has your property - your countries receive reinforcements for a certain amount of gold
- When you sell a certain resource of luxury in the market, you get more money for a certain percentage
... and 14 more types of bonuses - including the final study "Steam Turbine", which starts the Industrial Revolution and brings you Victory!

We hope that this update will allow you to see the game in a completely new light. And we want to announce that in about 2 months our new turn-base strategy / card butler - “The Fall of Rome” will be launched. We will make a serious step forward in visual design and the game from the start will be much bigger than EBM. Hope you enjoy it too ;)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825583/83cc35c3555e646fc18e53a6539f58e3ce84d06d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update! Revolutions are already in the game!
notes.notes:
Let me remind you that all the players held three votes, thanks to which you selected 3 updates for the game. We have already introduced two updates, and today we are introducing the third one - "Revolutions".

Now you will have the opportunity to organize national uprisings and help any nation to get their own state.
After the Revolution occurs, all property of other banks in these regions will be nationalized and you can thus deal a very serious blow to the competitors.

After the Revolution was successful and the country has appeared, it seeks to expand to the limits of its culture. Thus, after a successful Revolution, Germany will try to expand in all regions where the Germans live, and China in all regions where there are Chinese and so on.

In total, the game now has more than 140 nations (cultures), so the choice is large enough. We also essentially add a very strong competitive tool. If the AI ​​for some reason has invested a lot of money in expanding investments in a particular region - you can simply level it)

With this update we close two and a half months of endless updates and will gradually proceed to the next projects. But most likely in April we will return to Evil Bank Manager for some big DLC.
From myself and from Hamsters Gaming, I want to thank all those who supported us on the path to creating an Evil Bank Manager. Without you, it would not be that good. Without your ideas, your help, and without your approval and support. You are the best and hope to see you in our next projects!)
From your Hamsters Gaming
With love)

notes.title: Big balance update yesterday (20% of tables touched)
notes.notes:
A huge edit yesterday includes balance edits. Let me remind you that we promised to give the opportunity to play 1000 moves not on a record (the 301-1000th move will be available as a free game). We promised to introduce this update before the end of the year - so this update, among other things, solved the task of preparing the game for this goal.
What have we updated in the balance?

- When issuing a loan to another bank, the chance of bankruptcy of a competitor's bank increased by 2 times
- When issuing a loan to another bank, the percentage of profitability is increased. Now the maximum profitability from a loan issued to another bank can be 4.6% per turn (on the move 300+ not more than 3.4%)
- Reduced the difference between the cost of buying a rich region and the poor. The richest region is now 1.9 times as expensive as the poorest.
- The salaries of managers on the 300th move were reduced by 23%. Reduction proportional to all moves. Similarly, the progress of taxes for each region is reduced by 15%.
- 20% reduction in the progress of the purchase price of the license of the country, depending on the turn of the game
- Increased the basic number of property in the regions (in the poorest has not changed, in the richest an increase of + 20%)
- Increased natural growth of property available for purchase in the regions by 20%
- Changed AI. Added a rule that makes it difficult for AI to purchase property at a later stage. Now in the later stages, the AI ​​will get a little easier. at the same time, at the initial stage, simple AIs will become slightly stronger
- Reduced the influence of AI on the war (the most powerful AI will have a 40% less impact on the war, the weakest by 5%)
- Increased armies operated by countries (progress over the course of travel increased by 20%)
- Increased increase in available property when investing in it. Now for each gold invested, in the region there will be available a property for 6 gold instead of 5.
- The minimum recharge of investment in an increase in the property available for purchase is limited to 12 moves (after 184 moves)
- On high complexity, there are less of the most difficult opponents (6 instead of 8), on the ultra-complexity of such opponents will be 10 instead of 12
- Reduced the cost of 4, 6 and 7 country management skills 2.5, 3.3 and 4 times
- Reduced the increase in later resources (previously the resource that appeared on the 120th move brought 20% more profit than the usual one). Now the increase in the resource that appears on the 120th move + 12%. The resource that will appear on the 600th move in the future will bring 35% more resources than the usual one.
- Increased the maximum amount of investment you can buy (up to 1 million gold)
- Reduced the bonus of the building of the credit department, which gave to issue large loans. Now you can issue several credits per turn, but each of them will be for a smaller amount.

We continue to develop the game. We are going to add 3 more critically large updates (1000 moves, Revolutions and one more). And thank you for supporting Evil Bank Manager and Hamsters Gaming;)

notes.title: Huge update! (Third victory option, Difficulty levels, Records)
notes.notes:
Today we are introducing a big update, which we talked about yesterday.
- Difficulty levels (now there are 5 difficulty levels). The complexity depends on: the starting amount that you have in your account, the complexity of the AI, the record points you will receive at the end. The biggest difficulty is now really fun)
- Records. The record points consist of two parts: the move on which you won, as well as the number of gold that you had at the moment (plus the value of the property, plus the price you paid for entering the countries). The higher the complexity, the more points there will be of course.
- New bankruptcy mechanics. Now every turn has its own "Minimum" value of the bank, which it should have. If the bank value is below this level, it will be excluded from the race for leadership, as negligible. In fact, this mechanics complements the "Mercenaries" and now you can bankrupt competitors in a cascade.
- The third option is a victory. Now you can bankrupt your competitors and then you will also win. This is a very difficult victory, especially at high levels of difficulty, but it’s still more interesting, right?)
We also added a number of minor updates.
Tomorrow we will tune the localization in order to be fully armed by launch;)

Today I have finally drawn up a plan for all the updates and connected them into a single system. Most likely we will introduce all planned updates in the next two weeks. On the weekend I will write exactly what updates I have planned.

notes.notes:
Yesterday an update was introduced with the new mechanics - "Grants for small business".
In it, you can invest in the region so that there will be much more property available for purchase. Now you can become a pioneer of your country and make it much richer.
Also, such an update will help a lot at the later stage of the game (we are preparing to change game into 300 moves :). Now, when you are playing at a later stage, you will have no problems finding a country for investments - because you can give out grants for small businesses first and then buy up the businesses that have appeared.
The amount of your investment in the grants of each region is determined by your managers from the Investment Department (their total parameter "I"). Yes, now this parameter matters)

notes.title: Update (6 things we updated just now)
notes.notes:
Update some things you requested.
- Added: Now you have the opportunity to name your bank. You asked about it - we did it ;)
- Added: Ability to sell property in non-open countries for 50% of real value. On some lets plays, players can't understand why they get property from investing in a war, but they can't do anything with this property. Now you can sell such property, but at a very low price. In the end, if you do not have a branch in the country, then you will have to charge some realtors with the sale. Do you know what commissions were in the 16th century?)
- Improved: Global map display. Now the flickering of the card is much nicer, as are a number of other elements.
- Fixed: Bug with non-aggression of some countries in some situations. In fact, we corrected two errors (we added neighbors to the remaining island countries, and also decided a bug with the sometimes lack of neighbors of ordinary countries).
- Fixed: Earlier there were situations in which the IMF did not have time to sell 100% of its shares for 200 moves. Now IMF will sell large shares at a time
- Fixed: Corrected icons of war on the global map. Previously, sometimes there was a situation when the icon opened from the line and was shown in the capital, and not at the place of the war. Because of this, it sometimes seemed that there was no war, and then the region was captured instantly. Now this situation will not happen.

A big update is waiting for you tomorrow - so get ready) The game is essentially transformed!)

notes.title: New big update! Now you can provoke wars!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825583/2c259db0812e6c009048a77430de70d74bd18694.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33825583/a6c28645384794e625b80da2e3f64b424b9f8144.jpg[/img][/url]
Today we have introduced a new update - we added 7 political decisions that you can impose on a country with which you have good relations.
The better your relationship, the more types of decisions you can impose and the more often you will be able to do it.
Types of solutions:
1. You can increase the most important parameter of any region - agriculture, industry and real estate. This is a key parameter in determining the price of your property of this type and profitability. For example, if the "Agriculture" in the region is equal to "1", then your farm in the region generates 3.5% of the profit from its value. If the "Agriculture" in the region is equal to "20", then your farm brings more than 10% of the profit from its value. In addition, increasing these parameters increases the cost of ownership.
This parameter is always high in the capital, but if the country is large, then it can often turn out to be especially poor county districts.
2. Finally added the ability to provoke a country to war. When you use this solution, the king decides to launch an attack on one of the neighboring regions.
3. Nationalization of a part of the property of a competitor. When using this solution, country officials are very biased against a particular competitor, they are checking and take part of the property as a fine. What could be nicer than the grief of a neighbor, right?)
4. Freeze a competitor's license. A competitor license in your country temporarily stops working. He cannot buy property and cannot sell it. So, if a competitor enters a country - you can always stop his purchases until you buy back the remaining property.

Now the update is not well translated into languages ​​other than English - but by the end of the week we will fix the localization of other languages. Just decided that it is more important to release the update now and give you the opportunity to play it right away - because everyone loves the update, right?)

And you could plan with whom to negotiate for you is more important and what kind of deal you want to conclude.
2. Add more factions to play for. Now only the largest 8 fractions are represented in the game. It is clear that it is always more pleasant to play for your fraction of your country. Therefore, we can add more factions from Europe and Asia.
3. Add Guard additional use case. And what if your guards could be used as mercenaries? Want to improve your relationship with the king of France? Send your guards to the execution of dark orders, up to the murder of the claimant to the throne - and improve the relationship up to the maximum. Become a non-replaceable assistant to the rulers and get the maximum trust from their side. In addition, add the ability to use the Bank's Guard to fight competitors - up to the liquidation of the bank owner and, as a consequence, the competitor’s bankruptcy.
4. Add to the game of difficulty, records and scoring system, plus turn game to 300 turns mode. It is always nice to win, but one victory can be greater than another. And sometimes the round ends in defeat, but you were incredible and played one of the best matches against very strong competitors. But if this site is already done - you need to do it well. Add a serious scoring system, setting the difficulty. Plus there are some players that asked us about longer game. So in this update we will add changing game to 300 moves.
These are the options that I now see and that you offered. Options that scored the least last time - removed as the least interesting. We’ll add multiplayer in the next ballot - because it’s too early to do it) If you have additional ideas for future polls, write in the relevant topic in the discussions.
